mapper.select: SELECT FM.FTA_CODE , FM.HS_CODE , FTA.FTA_NAME , FM.AMOUNT , FTA.INKOTERMS_TYPE , FM.RULE_CONTENTS , FM.COMPANY_COO_YN , FR.RVC_COMPANY_RESULT_RATE AS RVC_RATE , FR.CTC_COMPANY_RESULT_RATE AS DE_MINIMIS_RATE FROM FCR_MST FM INNER JOIN FTA_MASTER FTA ON FM.COMPANY_CODE = FTA.COMPANY_CODE AND FM.FTA_CODE = FTA.FTA_CODE INNER JOIN FCR_RESULT FR ON FM.COMPANY_CODE = FR.COMPANY_CODE AND FM.DIVISION_CODE = FR.DIVISION_CODE AND FM.FTA_CODE = FR.FTA_CODE AND FM.SALES_NO = FR.SALES_NO AND FM.SALES_SEQ = FR.SALES_SEQ AND FM.RULE_CONTENTS = FR.RULE_CODE WHERE FM.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND FM.SALES_NO = #{sales_no} AND FM.SALES_SEQ = #{sales_seq}

SELECT FR.FTA_CODE , FR.RULE_CODE , NULL AS DE_MINIMIS_AMOUNT , FR.COMPANY_COO_YN , FM.AMOUNT , FM.OUTAREA_AMOUNT , FR.RVC_COMPANY_RESULT_RATE AS RVC_RATE , FRU.RULE_DESCRIPTION AS RULE_DESCRIPTION FROM FCR_RESULT FR LEFT JOIN FTA_RULE FRU ON FRU.HS_CODE = SUBSTR(FR.HS_CODE, 1, LENGTH(FRU.HS_CODE)) AND FRU.FTA_CODE = FR.FTA_CODE AND FRU.RULE_ID = FR.RULE_SEQ INNER JOIN FCR_MST FM ON FM.COMPANY_CODE = FR.COMPANY_CODE AND FM.DIVISION_CODE = FR.DIVISION_CODE AND FM.FTA_CODE = FR.FTA_CODE AND FM.SALES_NO = FR.SALES_NO AND FM.SALES_SEQ = FR.SALES_SEQ WHERE FR.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND FR.SALES_NO = #{sales_no} AND FR.SALES_SEQ = #{sales_seq}
